scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-core build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-history --filter @lupinum/vue-board -r build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-connections build && pnpm --filter nuxt-board build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter docs lint && pnpm --filter nuxt-board lint
scripts.test:docs: pnpm --filter docs typecheck && pnpm --filter docs build
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/basic.test.ts --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/prefixed.test.ts && pnpm --filter nuxt-board test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:workspace && pnpm --filter docs typecheck && pnpm --filter nuxt-board test:types
scripts.verify:library: pnpm --filter docs exec nuxt prepare && pnpm typecheck:workspace && pnpm --filter nuxt-board test:types && pnpm test:unit && pnpm pack:check
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm pack:check && pnpm test:docs
scripts.release:verify: pnpm verify && pnpm test:e2e:functional && pnpm changeset status
